design.manipulation: Granularity of the cut. A T=16 dichotomy sequence is partitioned as K∈{1,2,4} dichotomies per sequential task (fine / medium / coarse). Same 16 dichotomies and 16 arrangements. Each grouped task is a multi-output batch: every arrangement in the group is labeled with all K dichotomies of the group. Shared readout; outputs added; no task-conditioned head.
